# ZstdSharp

A managed port of Zstandard, which Loadout uses to read chd files compressed with it. Loadout's executable includes it.

- Source: [ZstdSharp](https://github.com/oleg-st/ZstdSharp), the `ZstdSharp.Port` package.
- Licence: MIT, in `LICENSE`. ZstdSharp is a port of [Zstandard](https://github.com/facebook/zstd), whose BSD licence is in `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt` at the top of this repository and of the downloads.
